crossRefs.note: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you…
For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same…
He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but rather that you would prophesy. For he is greater who…
So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
Let all things be done decently and in order.
But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the…
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

translations.web: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
translations.bsb: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
translations.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let ➔ all things be done unto edifying.
translations.asv: What is it then, brethren? When ye come together, each one hath a psalm, hath a teaching, hath a revelation, hath a tongue, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
